project.description_en: At the end of the theme, the child plays a journey game: reads the departure time, crosses the road safely, gives a robot car instructions, draws a vehicle with the flag on it and says what to do in a storm.

activities.goal_en: Recite a sound rhyme about vehicles.
activities.prompt_en: Say the rhyme and make the sounds of the vehicles!
steps_en: Say the rhyme with the sounds.
Repeat line by line.
Say it together, moving like each vehicle.
Ask: which vehicle goes on water?
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 34 (Poetry and Rhymes: Rhymes), p. 61; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.story_en:
Vroom goes the car on the long, long road,
Toot goes the truck with a heavy load,
Choo-choo goes the train, swish goes the boat,
And up in the sky the planes all float!

activities.prompt_en: Read: “The bus is red.” “The canoe is on the river.”
steps_en: Show sentence cards with pictures.
Read each sentence pointing to the words.
The child reads with you, then alone.
Ask a question about each sentence.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 36 (Reading: Short sentences and texts), p. 63; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

items: 🛶 The canoe is on the river.

activities.title_en: Writing travel words: bus, car, taxi
activities.prompt_en: Let us write the words of our journey: bus, car, taxi.
steps_en: Show the word cards with pictures.
Say each letter while tracing.
Copy each word.
Read the words aloud.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 37 (Writing: Letters and numbers), p. 64; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Say the days of the week in French and use one in a sentence.
activities.prompt_en: In French: lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche. “Samedi, on voyage !”
steps_en: Say the days, clapping.
The child repeats.
Find today’s day in French.
Say a sentence: “… , on voyage !”
observe_en: Uses a day in a sentence.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 38 (French: Les jours de la semaine), p. 65; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Read the time in hours and be punctual.
activities.prompt_en: The bus leaves at 8 o’clock. Show 8 o’clock on the clock.
steps_en: Show a clock face.
Place the hands for 8 o’clock.
Read a simple timetable with three o’clock times.
Say what we must do to be on time.
observe_en: Says why we must be on time.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 39 (Mathematics: Time), p. 66–67; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

interactive.prompt_en: The short hand is on 8 and the long hand is on 12. What time is it? (Write the hour)
interactive.explanation_en: The short hand shows the hour: it is 8 o’clock.

activities.goal_en: Give a series of instructions to a toy and see that computers need instructions.
activities.prompt_en: A robot only does what we tell it. Tell the robot car: forward, forward, turn right!
steps_en: One child is the “robot car”; the others give instructions.
Use only: forward, back, turn left, turn right, stop.
Guide the robot to a target (the garage).
Talk: what happens if an instruction is wrong?
materials_en: a toy car or a child as the robot
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 40 (Information and Communication Technologies: Basic notions of programming), p. 68–70; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Recognise natural phenomena and protect oneself.
activities.prompt_en: When there is thunder and lightning, we go inside a house. We do not play in flood water.
steps_en: Show pictures of a storm and a flood.
Talk about what we see and hear.
Say the safety rules.
Act: a storm comes; the children go inside calmly.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 42 (Science and Technology: Natural phenomena), p. 73–75; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Follow road safety rules and the traffic lights.
activities.prompt_en: Red: stop! Yellow: wait! Green: go, but look first!
steps_en: Make a traffic light with red, yellow and green papers.
Children walk or “drive”; change the light.
They stop, wait or go.
Practise crossing with an adult at a zebra crossing drawn on the ground.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 47 (Safety Education: Road safety), p. 80; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Identify air and noise pollution and stay away from them.
activities.prompt_en: Old cars make black smoke and lots of horns make noise. Both are bad for our health.
steps_en: Show pictures of smoke and of a noisy road.
Ask: how do we feel with smoke? with noise?
Talk about walking, cycling and keeping cars in good condition.
Practise a quiet voice and covering the nose near smoke.
observe_en: Names smoke and noise as pollution.
Says one way to reduce them.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 46 (Environmental Education: Pollution), p. 79; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Roads and buses belong to everyone
activities.prompt_en: Roads, buses and bus stops are for everybody. We keep them clean and do not damage them.
steps_en: Show pictures of a bus stop and a road.
Ask: who uses them?
List good actions (keep clean, give a seat to an old person).
Act a bus trip with good manners.
observe_en: Gives a seat in the role play.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 44 (Citizenship: Common good), p. 77; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: A bus with the flag of Cameroon
activities.goal_en: Draw with shapes and colour the flag of Cameroon.
activities.prompt_en: Draw a bus with a rectangle and circles. Put a little flag on it: green, red with a yellow star, yellow.
steps_en: Draw a big rectangle and two circles.
Add windows with squares.
Draw a small rectangle for the flag and divide it in three.
Colour the flag: green, red, yellow, and the star.
observe_en: Colours the flag in the right order.
Places the star on the red band.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 50 (Drawing and Colouring: Shapes and colouring), p. 83; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery Two contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery Two teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Carrying a load on a line
activities.goal_en: Keep balance while carrying an object along a line.
activities.prompt_en: Walk along the line carrying a bag in each hand, like a traveller.
steps_en: Draw a straight line.
Walk along it with one light bag.
Then with two bags.
Then carrying a small basket on the head with one hand.
source_refs: Nursery Two, table 53 (Physical Education and Sports: Gymnastics), p. 86; theme 8: Travelling (table 13, p. 37)

scale.description: Succeeds mostly with a model or help.
Sometimes succeeds alone, sometimes with a reminder.
Succeeds on their own in a familiar situation.

indicators: Recites a sound rhyme about vehicles.
Reads a short sentence about transport.
Reads an o’clock time on a timetable.
Gives step-by-step instructions to a toy.
Says what to do in a storm.
Draws and colours the flag of Cameroon.

sources: Cameroon Nursery School Curriculum, English Subsystem, MINEDUB, 2018: table 13 (integrated learning themes), p. 37; Nursery Two tables, cited and not reproduced.
